schema.description: One file in a documents library: a pointer to the bytes, which stay in the library and never enter the ledger. Written by the documents source (the default library beside the ledger, or a declared one), from the file itself and its .meta.yaml sidecar. Version 2 requires source_time (card 198), every other rule unchanged.

bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, measured by the documents worker when it reads the file. Not from the sidecar, which may not set it.

date.description: The document's own date (not the day it was scanned or filed), the sidecar's date key, as YYYY-MM-DD in Sydney. Required: a file without it refuses the scan. This is the fact time.

media_type.description: The media type the worker names from the file's extension, parameters stripped; the bytes are not sniffed. application/octet-stream when the extension is unknown. Not from the sidecar.

note.description: The sidecar's note key, free text written by whoever filed the document, verbatim.

path.description: The file's path relative to the library root, with forward slashes; it may include subfolders. The root itself never enters the fact. This is the identity, so a renamed file is a new facet.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes as lower-case hex, computed by the worker. Changed bytes at the same path supersede the facet.

title.description: The sidecar's title key, free text written by whoever filed the document, verbatim.

source_time.description: How the sidecar's date was read (card 198): value is the date the sidecar gives, a day with no time of day, read in Australia/Sydney, the zone this Definition reads date in, with nothing else behind it (basis assumption); the anam_documents importer logs it.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
